content.text: {"route":"gap","reason":"The record has material gaps that should be filled before a merits decision. The investigator did not question Complainant on claims 1-3 and 5-9 and only asked her to verify them. None of the six coworkers she named as witnesses (Coworkers 2-7) gave affidavits, and no reason is given for not contacting them. Those witnesses were the people who could corroborate the alleged retaliation, the spreading of information, and the exclusion. The record also has no detail on the conversation the day before the warning letter, and no comparator evidence on the probationary warning. The only management evidence on the contested claims is the Supervisor's own responses. The other officials interviewed had little or no knowledge of the claims. Under these conditions the FAD's finding of no discrimination or retaliation cannot be reliably evaluated."}
